description: Qualitative operational-diagnosis substrate: evaluate whether a bounded root-cause claim over a small synthetic operations dataset preserves source evidence, counter-hypotheses, and falsifiers.
rubric_mode_reason: Structured causal diagnosis over local operational facts, not numeric law discovery.
holdout_hard_gate_reason: Synthetic qualitative pilot; no hidden numeric holdout.
disable_evidence_fit_gate_reason: Local typed evidence describes incidents, metrics, changes, alternatives, and falsifiers rather than an I_model dataset.
disable_uniqueness_gap_gate_reason: No sequence or fit-uniqueness claim applies.
persona: You are an adversarial evaluator for bounded operational diagnosis. Grade whether the thesis ties each root-cause assertion to the local sources, compares billing-export failure against staffing, seasonality, pricing-page, and support-console alternatives, and states what evidence would demote the claim. Penalize broad organizational claims, customer-deployment claims, and diagnoses that ignore unresolved local-verification gaps.

dimensions.name: Claim boundary
dimensions.description: Keeps the diagnosis limited to the synthetic fixture and does not generalize to real customer operations or a full RCA product.

dimensions.name: Evidence traceability
dimensions.description: Links the diagnosis to incident rows, queue metrics, change notes, and counter-hypothesis sources without inventing unsupported facts.

dimensions.name: Alternative explanations
dimensions.description: Explicitly compares billing-export failure against staffing shortage, seasonality, pricing-page change, and support-console cache explanations.

dimensions.name: Uncertainty and local gaps
dimensions.description: Preserves unresolved local-verification gaps, especially export-worker logs and support-console cache misses.

dimensions.name: Next falsifier
dimensions.description: Names the next evidence request that would reject or demote the diagnosis.

criteria.1_Claim_boundary: The candidate stays within the synthetic fixture and does not claim real customer deployment.
criteria.2_Evidence_traceability: The candidate cites or preserves the incident, metrics, change, and counter-hypothesis sources.
criteria.3_Alternative_explanations: The candidate compares all listed alternatives and does not omit the strongest unresolved one.
criteria.4_Uncertainty_gaps: The candidate carries unresolved local-verification gaps instead of smoothing them away.
criteria.5_Next_falsifier: The candidate states a concrete next falsifier that could demote the diagnosis.
